#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <limits>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

using i64 = long long;

struct Edge {
    int to, rev;
    i64 cap, flow;
    i64 cost;
};

class MCMF {
public:
    int n;
    std::vector<std::vector<Edge>> adj;
    std::vector<i64> dist, potential, flow_in;
    std::vector<int> parent_node, parent_edge;

    MCMF(int size) : n(size), adj(size), dist(size), potential(size), flow_in(size), parent_node(size), parent_edge(size) {}

    void add_edge(int from, int to, i64 capacity, i64 cost) {
        Edge forward = {to, (int)adj[to].size(), capacity, 0, cost};
        Edge backward = {from, (int)adj[from].size(), 0, 0, -cost};
        adj[from].push_back(forward);
        adj[to].push_back(backward);
    }

    std::pair<i64, i64> min_cost_max_flow(int source, int sink) {
        i64 total_flow = 0, total_cost = 0;

        // Initialize potentials using Bellman-Ford
        std::fill(potential.begin(), potential.end(), LLONG_MAX);
        potential[source] = 0;
        bool updated;
        for (int iter = 0; iter < n; ++iter) {
            updated = false;
            for (int u = 0; u < n; ++u) {
                if (potential[u] == LLONG_MAX) continue;
                for (int i = 0; i < adj[u].size(); ++i) {
                    Edge& e = adj[u][i];
                    if (e.cap > e.flow && potential[e.to] > potential[u] + e.cost) {
                        potential[e.to] = potential[u] + e.cost;
                        updated = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!updated) break;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            if (potential[i] == LLONG_MAX) potential[i] = 0;
        }

        while (true) {
            // Dijkstra with potentials
            std::fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), LLONG_MAX);
            std::fill(parent_node.begin(), parent_node.end(), -1);
            std::priority_queue<std::pair<i64, int>, std::vector<std::pair<i64, int>>, std::greater<std::pair<i64, int>>> pq;
            dist[source] = 0;
            pq.push({0, source});

            while (!pq.empty()) {
                auto [d, u] = pq.top();
                pq.pop();
                if (d != dist[u]) continue;

                for (int i = 0; i < adj[u].size(); ++i) {
                    Edge& e = adj[u][i];
                    if (e.cap > e.flow) {
                        i64 new_dist = dist[u] + e.cost + potential[u] - potential[e.to];
                        if (new_dist < dist[e.to]) {
                            dist[e.to] = new_dist;
                            parent_node[e.to] = u;
                            parent_edge[e.to] = i;
                            pq.push({new_dist, e.to});
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (dist[sink] == LLONG_MAX) break;

            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                if (dist[i] != LLONG_MAX) {
                    potential[i] += dist[i];
                }
            }

            i64 flow = LLONG_MAX;
            for (int v = sink; v != source; v = parent_node[v]) {
                int u = parent_node[v];
                int idx = parent_edge[v];
                flow = std::min(flow, adj[u][idx].cap - adj[u][idx].flow);
            }

            for (int v = sink; v != source; v = parent_node[v]) {
                int u = parent_node[v];
                int idx = parent_edge[v];
                adj[u][idx].flow += flow;
                adj[v][adj[u][idx].rev].flow -= flow;
                total_cost += flow * adj[u][idx].cost;
            }

            total_flow += flow;
        }

        return {total_flow, total_cost};
    }
};

int main() {
    std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m, k;
    i64 c, d;
    std::cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;

    std::vector<int> count(n + 1, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        int x;
        std::cin >> x;
        count[x]++;
    }

    // Build graph: for each time step t (0 to k*n), we have nodes t*n + 1..t*n + n
    // Plus a sink node
    int max_time = k * n + 1;
    int sink = max_time * n;
    MCMF network(max_time * n + 1);

    // Add edges for streets
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int u, v;
        std::cin >> u >> v;
        for (int t = 0; t < max_time - 1; ++t) {
            // For each time step, add edge from u to v and v to u
            // Cost: d * (2*j-1)^2 + c*(2*j-1) for j-th person using the edge at time t
            // But we simplify: for the j-th unit of flow (1-indexed), cost = d*(2*j-1)^2 + c*(2*j-1)
            for (int j = 1; j <= k; ++j) {
                i64 cost = d * (2*j - 1) * (2*j - 1) + c * (2*j - 1);
                network.add_edge(t * n + (u - 1), (t + 1) * n + (v - 1), 1, cost);
                network.add_edge(t * n + (v - 1), (t + 1) * n + (u - 1), 1, cost);
            }
        }
    }

    // Add waiting edges
    for (int t = 0; t < max_time - 1; ++t) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= k; ++j) {
                i64 cost = d * (2*j - 1) * (2*j - 1) + c * (2*j - 1);
                network.add_edge(t * n + i, (t + 1) * n + i, 1, cost);
            }
        }
    }

    // Add edges from node 1 (crossroad 1) to sink with 0 cost
    for (int t = 0; t < max_time; ++t) {
        network.add_edge(t * n + 0, sink, k, 0);
    }

    // Add source edges
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        if (count[i] > 0) {
            network.add_edge(sink + 1, (i - 1), count[i], 0);
        }
    }

    // Add super source
    int source = sink + 1;
    network.n = source + 1;
    network.adj.resize(source + 1);
    network.dist.resize(source + 1);
    network.potential.resize(source + 1);
    network.flow_in.resize(source + 1);
    network.parent_node.resize(source + 1);
    network.parent_edge.resize(source + 1);

    std::cout << network.min_cost_max_flow(source, sink).second << '\n';
    return 0;
}
